examples.text: Kleinen Kinder sabbeln, wenn sie den Beißring in den Mund stecken und auf ihm herumkauen.

glosses: To secrete saliva, especially in anticipation of food.

To react to something with uncontrollable desire.

examples.text: That boy is so attractive I drool whenever I see him!

examples.text: He blabbered away about how he knew where some treasure was hidden and he would tell us if only we would swear to save his life.

glosses: To blab; to reveal a secret.
